cli.description:
streamer-vm is a CLI tool designed to manage QEMU+KVM virtual machines with VirGL
GPU acceleration, SPICE display, and seamless OBS Studio capture integration.
cli.workflow.step1: Verify host prerequisites (KVM, GPU DRM, QEMU, OVMF) and prepare directories.
cli.workflow.step2: Create a new VM writing directly to base disk (setup mode, no initial overlay).
cli.workflow.step3: Start the VM to install the guest OS via SPICE display (spicy/virt-viewer).
cli.workflow.step4: Gracefully stop the VM once OS installation is completed.
cli.workflow.step5: Bake installed OS as base image, detach ISO, and activate COW overlay.
cli.workflow.step6: Run the VM using COW overlay for streaming and recording via OBS Studio.
cli.workflow.step7: Discard overlay changes and revert back to clean base image (last commit).
cli.flags_help: Show help information (run 'streamer-vm help <command>' for details)

cmd.init.short: Initialize streamer-vm environment and verify host prerequisites
cmd.init.long: Creates required directory structure under STREAMER_HOME and verifies host prerequisites (KVM, GPU DRM, QEMU, OVMF firmware).
cmd.create.short: Create a new virtual machine configuration and disk images
cmd.create.long: Creates base qcow2 disk, prepares UEFI OVMF variables, and generates vm.json configuration.
cmd.start.long: Launches QEMU in background daemon mode and waits for the SPICE display server to be ready.
cmd.stop.long: Gracefully requests ACPI shutdown via QEMU monitor socket, falling back to SIGTERM/SIGKILL if necessary.
cmd.update.short: Update VM configuration (e.g. attach or remove ISO)
cmd.update.long: Updates configuration options of an existing virtual machine, such as attaching or removing an ISO image.
cmd.commit.short: Commit VM changes to base image and prepare overlay
cmd.commit.long: Stops the VM if running, commits current overlay changes (or initializes first overlay if in setup mode) to the base image, saves UEFI vars, and optionally removes the installation ISO.
cmd.reset.short: Reset VM overlay disk back to base image state
cmd.reset.long: Stops the VM if running, removes the overlay qcow2 disk, and recreates a fresh overlay linked to the base disk image.
cmd.status.short: Show status of a specific virtual machine or all VMs
cmd.status.long: Displays running status, PID, Spice port, CPUs, RAM, and disk information for a VM.
cmd.list.long: Lists all configured virtual machines and their current operational status.
cmd.delete.short: Delete a virtual machine configuration and disk images
cmd.delete.long: Stops the VM if running, removes configuration and backing disk files (base and overlay).
cmd.spice_url.short: Print the SPICE connection URL for a VM
cmd.spice_url.long: Displays the spice:// or spice+unix:// connection URI to connect using spicy or virt-viewer.
